note: Reads the next orderly-RAM entry size from input-controlled NVRAM state.
The code assumes a zero-sized terminator exists and stops only when it sees one, but the array can be completely filled with no room for that terminator.
Advances through the array by the claimed entry size, carrying the traversal state toward the end of the 512-byte region.
When the array is full and no terminator exists, the next iteration dereferences the end of the buffer as if another header were present.
